name: host-overflow-claude-code
title: Productize Lattice Host Overflow for Claude Code overflow workers
description: When Codex subagent capacity is not enough, Lattice should provide a host-neutral overflow path that can hand bounded tasks to Claude Code while preserving story authority, scope, receipt, evidence, and review gates. This story implements the first production slice: capability reporting, handoff pack creation, manual receipt submit, isolated worktree guidance, supervised dispatch projection, docs, and smoke tests.
